افتديتم (form VIII)
# اِفْتَدَيْتُمْ (iftadaytum) /if.ta.daj.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِفْتَدَى (iftadā)
# اُفْتُدِيتُمْ (uftudītum) /uf.tu.diː.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِفْتَدَى (iftadā)
